blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Toyota Motor Philippines Corp. warned that nearly a month of flooding in Thailand could disrupt shipments of some of its imported vehicles. Since mid-September, floods have inundated parts of Thailand, resulting in at least 71 deaths and disrupting operations at several automakers and parts manufacturers.
